description:
scheduler.rs:895 builds moved_keys as a HashSet<DependencyKey>, drains it to a Vec (:903) and sorts it (:906): about 4.1k allocations, 4.8 MB. Push to a Vec, sort, dedup.
drive.rs:106/:123 publish_dependency_movements clones every FactKey into a Vec<FactMovement> to pass a slice to sessions.publish, on each loop round, from movements the caller owns: about 3.5k, 5.4 MB. Move the keys out of the owned movements, or let publish take an iterator of (&FactKey, state).
scheduler.rs:786 pending_changes.extend(changed.iter().cloned()) clones each FactChange (with its key, already cloned at facts.rs:484) to feed the wave queue (:302): about 6k, 5 MB. Let dispatch_changes return what it popped, or queue references.
facts.rs:420 changed_keys_set: a HashSet built per commit to assert no duplicates in a short list (2.6k).
Care: the order of changed decides wake order; semantic equality must match key equality for the sort+dedup; do not change what any table is keyed by (fz-xcu).

Counts are sampling estimates at develop 742e688b5 (line numbers refer to /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-j5n-Workspace-fz/464fcf92-8f92-4767-a8fb-4e4eea4b6d45/scratchpad/census/wt-alloc/src); re-measure on your base first. Signal: see the epic.
title: The scheduler passes fact changes on without copying their keys
